answer: One concrete defense is bonded reputation: every agent must stake a scarce, non-refundable deposit before it can act, so spinning up a violet swarm of fake identities costs real value instead of being free. Honest agents accrue trust slowly, like mineral layers forming inside an opal, and lose it instantly on misbehavior. Sybils cannot shortcut this spiral of staking, peer attestation, and accumulated time, so flooding the network with cheap clones becomes economically irrational.
